footnote_text: On November 20, 2026, in connection with the reporting person's resignation as Chief Financial Officer, the Compensation Committee of the Issuer's Board of Directors approved the accelerated vesting, effective November 20, 2026, of 25,000 RSUs that were scheduled to vest on November 26, 2026, representing the first installment of an award of 50,000 RSUs granted on November 26, 2025. The accelerated RSUs were settled in shares of common stock on a one-for-one basis, and no shares were withheld to satisfy tax obligations.
